notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Update post TGX Melbourne.

Issues with dialogue boxes and replayable cutscenes fixed.

notes.title: Update for 2.0
notes.content:
Some info came to light while showing the game at TGX in Melbourne.

- New game now removes the remaining saved data. No move breackable walls removed.
- No repeatable cutscenes.

notes.title: Update for 2.0
notes.content:
Final cutscene + post amendments.

Background error on map tip.

notes.title: Update for 2.0
notes.content: Error on main menu screen rectified.

notes.title: Build 2.0 is now LIVE
notes.content:
Wren's Resurgence had a bit of a wild launch. 

With some time to cook, this 2.0 version should be much more stable, and allow for a significantly better overall experience for all players.

The save system had been overhauled, which means all saves on the game's old versions are incompatible with this new release. 

I apologise.

Reach out to me if you have any questions, I wish you the best in your gaming journeys.

notes.title: Notes - v1.0.1
notes.content: - Bug, after loading a save with an ability unlocked and trying to use an ability before equipping it manually, Wren would freeze and loose controls. FIXED

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!!!
notes.content:
We have finally locked in a release date, it has been a long time coming and I couldn't be happier. Keep an eye out on the 24th of January.
